result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my overall recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify. In that case, I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your website platform, where your customers are located, and how much you sell.

## Best payment processors compared

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- Credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and recurring payments.
- Excellent reporting and fraud prevention tools.

Website: [Stripe Canada](https://stripe.com/ca)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- No additional third-party transaction fee when using Shopify Payments.
- Convenient for managing orders and refunds.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many customers.
- Customers can pay using PayPal or eligible cards.
- Easy to add to an existing store.
- Good secondary payment option.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Integrates payments, inventory and point-of-sale systems.
- Straightforward for smaller businesses.

Website: [Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store in Canada\:

| Situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify website | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce website | Stripe |
| Custom-built website | Stripe |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Want another trusted checkout option | PayPal |


Stripe and Shopify Payments are particularly good starting points. Published rates and eligibility vary by country and payment type. [www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
